This is my small maize garden near home, only a tenth of an acre, so I want to make it count since maize is what feeds us. I will try to use the FISP coupon fertilizer if I get one this year — on such a small plot a little goes far, and I will add some manure from the chickens and kitchen ash too. I cannot afford pesticide or to hire people; my sister and I will weed it ourselves, and since it is intercropped with beans and pumpkins it does not need so many days. We have no way to irrigate, we wait for the rains like everyone.
